tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ka)

1 ༈ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pa'i don gyi tshul la cung zad bsngags pa yangs pa'i snying po dri med 'od bzang kun snang nor bu zab mo'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ston pa don kun grub pa'i bstod pa/ 2 ༈ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po dbyer med pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1 ༈ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 2 ༈ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po gzungs rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 3 ༈ rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrogs pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 4 ༈ byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po smon lam rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 5 ༈ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po ting 'dzin rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 6 ༈ rgyal sras nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 7

༈ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po rnam thar rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 8 nye sras brgyad bstod/ 3 ༈ 'khor lo'i mgon po'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i lhag pa'i lha yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa'i tshogs phreng bar bstar ba yongs su sbyangs pa'i baiḍūr+ya'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ 4 ༈ dpal he ru ka la bstod phyag 'tshal ba bde chen rol ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bde mchog bstod pa/ 5 ༈ sgrol bstod/ 6 ༈ pha dam pa sangs rgyas la bsngags pa brjod pa dpa' bo'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs/ pha dam pa'i bstod pa/ 7 ༈ rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon chen po zla ba'i zhabs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa dbyangs kyi yan lag brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tsaṇ+ḍa go mi'i bstod pa/ 8 ༈ mkhan slob chos gsum gyi bstod pa/ 9 ༈ khyung po'i gdung rabs rags bsdus kyi gsol 'debs bkra shis dbyangs snyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// khyung po'i gdung rab la bsngags pa/ 10 ༈ rje btsun ras chung pa rdo rje grags pa la bsngags pa rdo rje'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ras chung pa la bsngags pa/ 11 ༈ 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal ldan karma pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor cung zad bsngags pa/ kun bzang 'khor lo'i re'u mig tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// karma pa'i sku bstod/ 12 ༈ yon tan thugs kyi gnas mchog tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi gsol 'debs rgyas pa mkha' spyod rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// karma par kun bzang 'khor los bsngags pa/ 13 ༈ dpal chos kyi rgyal po ngharma ka ra la mos gus kyi bden gtam du bsngags pa bzhugs so// sid+dhi dharma ka ra'i sku bstod/ 14 ༈ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la bstod smon du sbyar ba bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dgongs 'dus lha tshogs la bstod smon/ 15 ༈ rdo rje'i ye shes 'bebs pa'i byin rlabs lam zab kyi phreng ba yongs 'dus ljon pa'i skyed tshal ces bya ba bzhugs so// lam zab yongs 'dus/ 16 ༈ 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal mchog bcu bzhi pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa nges don lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// ka rabs bcu bzhi'i bla mchod chog 17 ༈ mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang sgrub smin byed dang bcas pa zab gsang sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// mar pa'i bla sgrub/ 18 ༈ rje btsun mar pa lo tsa'i bla sgrub las gsang sgrub dbang gi cho ga bklags chog tu bkod pa byin rlabs sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// mar pa'i bla sgrub kyi dbang chog ldeb/ 19 ༈ rje btsun ras pa chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs mchod dang bcas pa ye shes dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi la'i bla sgrub/ 20 ༈ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur byin rlabs dang 'brel ba ye shes bcud sbyin ces bya ba bzhugs so// mi la'i bla sgrub kyi dbang chog 21 ༈ rje btsun ras pa chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi zin bris ye shes gsal byed bzhugs so// mi la'i bla sgrub kyi zin bris/ 22 ༈ gangs can mgon po dpal ldan karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs zung 'jug lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// karma pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 23 ༈ rdzogs pa chen po man ngag snying thig gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa mchod pa'i cho ga kun bzang rnam par rol pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// snying thig ma bu'i bla mchod/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (kha) 1 ༈ brgyud pa kun 'dus kyi bla ma mchod pa'i tshul tshogs kyi cho ga dang bcas mdor byas pa sna tshogs nor bu'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/bstod tshogs 'phros brgyud pa kun 'dus kyi bla mchod/ 2 ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug mchog sbyor ces bya ba bzhugs so// 3 ༈ mos gus kyi rabs las skyes pa'i thugs rje mngon par bskul ba'i tshig phreng skal ldan 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gsol 'debs mos gus rab byed/ 4 ༈ dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs rje mngon par skul ba'i bstod dbyangs nor bu snang yangs kyi rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku bstod/ 5 ༈ rigs gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor skal bzang 'dod 'jo bzhugs so// 6 ༈ paṇa chen shākya shrī la rnam thar dang rjes su mthun pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa dri med dpal mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gsol 'debs/ 7 ༈ 'gro mgon shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shangs chos bla mchod/ 8 ༈ rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lha'i thugs rje bskul ba rdo rje rta'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rtsa gsum gsol 'debs/ 9 ༈ tā'i si tu pad+ma'i ljags ldan drug gi thog mar byon pa rdo rje 'chang pad+ma dbang chen la gsol ba 'debs pa mos gus kyi chu skyes rnam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// si tu pad+ma nyin byed kyi gsol 'debs/ 10 ༈ sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kun 'dus kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga byin rlabs dngos grub yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi bla mchod/ 11 ༈ dpal chen yang dag he ru ka zla gam dgu pa'i sgrub thabs khrag 'thung mngon par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// snga 'gyur rnying ma bka' ma 'khon lugs yang dag sgrub thabs/ 12 ༈ dpal chen yang dag he ru ka zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dkyil chog dang dbang gi cho ga 13 ༈ dpal chen yang dag he ru ka'i snying po zla gam gcig ma la brten pa'i bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya ba'i yi ge thugs kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bsnyen yig / sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ga) 1 ༈ mkhon lugs phur pa jo nang rje btsun ta ra na tha'i sgrub dkyil la mdzes rgyan gsar du gnang ba rdo rje phur pa bdud 'joms rol pa'i dkar chags dang brgyud yig 2 ༈ rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu bzhugs so// 3 ༈ dpal rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu'i 'grel pa snying po bsdus pa dpal chen dgyes pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu 'grel pa/ 4 ༈ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub skor bzhugs so// 5 ༈ slob ma dbang bskur bar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs so// 6 ༈ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ dkyil chog 7 ༈ rdo rje phur pa 'khon lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gsol 'debs/ 8 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i tshe 'gugs kyi phrin las dwangs ma bcud bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshe 'gugs/ 9 ༈ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang bskur ba'i lag len gsal bar byed pa bdud rtsi'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// stod las dbang chog 10 ༈ 'khon lugs rdo rje phur pa'i gtor dbang gi yi ge byin rlabs bcud kyi thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gtor dbang*/ 11 ༈ dpal chen po rdo rje phur pa'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes su gnang ba'i yi ge bdud bzhi'i g.yul 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so// smad las/ 12 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i rgyun gyi nyams len bya ba'i rim pa thugs kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgyun khyer/ 13 ༈ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid yig sa bon tsam smos pa rdo rje'i gsang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// bskyed rdzogs khrid yig 14 ༈ bsnyen sgrub nyams len/ 15 ༈ rdo rje phur pa mkhon lugs kyi bsnyen yig dpal chen thugs thig ces bya ba bzhugs so// bsnyen yig 16 ༈ yang phur thun mong gi man ngag a ti'i khrid yig thar pa'i sgo gcig ces bya ba bzhugs so// khrid yig 17 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las gtor zlog gi lag len gsal bar bkod pa rdo rje gnam lcags 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gtor bzlog / sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (nga) 1 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub rten gyi gnad dang*/ mngon spyod gzer kha'i bcas kyi rim pa rnam par gsal ba thos chung yid kyi bcud 'dzin ces bya ba bzhugs so// mkhon lugs phur pa'i 'phros mngon spyod gzer kha/ 2 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor zlog gi 'don 'grigs mthong bas go 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs/ 3 ༈ ling khrus nor bu chu dwangs bzhugs so// ling khrus/ 4 ༈ gser skyems bzhugs so// 5 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu gtso 'khor srung mar bcas pa'i bstod bskul gsol kha sbrel ba lha'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bstod bskul/ 6 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la nye bar mkho ba'i yig sna phran tshegs phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// bsnyen sgrub la nyer mkho/ 7 ༈ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon spyod las la nye bar mkho ba'i yig chung sbas pa mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// mngon spyod la nyer mkho/ 8 ༈ dpal chen po rdo rje phur pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg phrin las gzi brjid dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 9 ༈ yang dag he ru ka 'khon lugs zla gam dgu pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nyes pa kun sbyong zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sbyin sreg 10 ༈ dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur thun mong gi bka' srung dka' bdud lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// bka' srung*/ 11 ༈ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i phrin las kyi sgo nas/ dgra dur phung gsum mnan pa'i man ngag rdo rje thog brtsegs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mnan pa'i man ngag 12 ༈ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa khro dkar gyi gzungs kyi cho ga dbang bskur dang bcas pa dag byed shel gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam 'joms khro dkar/ 13 ༈ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa khro nag lha bco lnga pa'i sgrub thabs gzungs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa sbyong byed rdo rje'i bum pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam 'joms khro nag sgrub thabs/ 14 ༈ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa khro nag lha bco lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga smin byed ye shes bum pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam 'joms dkyil chog dbang bskur/ 15 ༈ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rgyun gyi dbang chog 'gro don char rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so// thugs rje gsang 'dus rnal 'byor rgyun dbang*/ 16 ༈ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bshad rgyas bsdus 'phri bsnan gyis gsal ba bzhugs so// thugs rje gsang 'dus kyi dbang bshad/ 17 ༈ rtsa gsum snying bcud bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang bskur yongs rdzogs kyi lag len dngos grub rgya mtsho'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dgongs 'dus dbang zin/ 18 ༈ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ dpa' bo rkyang sgrub dang gsal byed thugs kyi nor bu'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge bdud rtsi stong gi zab bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi bsnyen yig

/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ca) 1 ༈ yi dam dgongs 'dus spyi sdom spros bcas dbang chen smin grol rgya mtsho dbang rkyang lugs su bskur ba'i zin tho bzhugs/ stag sham yi dam dgongs 'dus dbang zin/ 2 ༈ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang chen sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i lhan thabs zhi ba'i sreg blugs bsdus pa zla ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 3 ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub nor bu rgya mtsho'i sku gsum sgrub pa nyams su len bder bkod pa'i zin bris rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// pad gling thugs sgrub nor rgya mtsho'i sku gsum sgrub pa'i zin bris/ 4 ༈ gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i gsang sgrub me'i 'khor lo'i rgyun khyer gnam lcags tshwa tshwa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gsang bdag gtum po'i rgyun khyer/ 5 ༈ phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi lag len bzhugs so//

rata phur drag sreg 6 ༈ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ tshe 'das gnas 'dren 'gro drug rang grol bklags chog tu bsdebs pa yid gnyis rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kar gling zhi khro'i gnas 'dren rgyas pa 'gro drug rang grol chog khrigs/ 7 ༈ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi tshe 'das gnas 'dren thugs rje'i lcags kyu khyer bder bkod pa bzhugs so// gnas 'dren bsdus pa/ 8 ༈ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal nyes ltung rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zhi khro'i bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal/ 9 ༈ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ bla ma brgyud pa'i don bskang 'brel tshad rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// brgyud pa'i don bskang*/ 10 ༈ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi nang sgrub rgyun khyer byin rlabs rgya mtsho bzhugs so// 'ja' tshon thugs chen ngan song rang grol/ 11 ༈ zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zung 'jug rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rta phag yid nor gsol 'debs/ 12 ༈ dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i dgongs gter bsam lhun gsol 'debs/ 13 ༈ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs thugs rje'i chu rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so// 'ja' tshon thugs chen ngan rang grol/ 14 ༈ stag sham yi dam dgongs 'dus dbang tho/ 15 ༈ zab lam thugs kyi nor bu las/ rtsa ba'i sgrub chen dang bdud rtsi sman sgrub gnyis kyi sgrub khog zung 'brel du bkod pa grub gnyis bdud rtsi'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs so// chos gling zab lam thugs nor sgrub khog 16 ༈ zab lam thugs kyi nor bu las/ las bzhi mchog lnga'i sbyin sreg gi lag len 'dus gsal du bkod pa nor bu sna tshogs mdog can zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

de'i sbyin sreg lag len/ 17 ༈ tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi bskang ba 'chi med 'dod 'jo'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i skong ba/ 18 ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge mdor bsdus gnam lcags lde'u mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// stag sham bdud 'dul drag mo'i bsnyen sgrub zin bris/ 19 ༈ rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang gi lag len mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa sos ka'i sprin gyi rnga dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// yong dge'i gro lod dbang chog 20 ༈ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus chen gyi bsnyen pa'i lag len til mar sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bka' brgyad bde 'dus bsnyen yig 21 ༈ rtsa ba'i thugs sgrub dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi dbang bskur bklags chog tu bkod pa grub gnyis bdud rtsi'i bcud 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mchog gling thugs sgrub dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi dbang chog 22 ༈ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rgyud sde bzhi sbrags zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyud sde bzhi sgrub rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ 23 ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las/ sme ba brtsegs ba'i sgrub thabs khyer bde bzhugs so// thugs sgrub sme brtsegs/ 24 ༈ sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (cha) 1 ༈ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bskur bklag chog tu bkod pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i bcud 'dren ces bya ba bzhugs so// jo lugs dus 'khor dbang chings ye shes rgya mtsho'i bcud 'dren/ 2 ༈ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum sta gon dbang zin/ 3 ༈ 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i sgrub thabs bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i sgrub thabs/ 4 ༈ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer dam tshig nges pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer/ 5 ༈ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i mchod chog mdor bsdus bde chen rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i mchod chog 6 ༈ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa ba'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga bklags chog tu bkod pa ut+pal ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa ba'i dbang chog ut+pal ljon shing*/ 7 ༈ dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga ye shes sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rig gtad ye shes sgo 'byed/ 8 ༈ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bsgom bzlas rdo rje'i ya lad ces bya ba bzhugs so// 9 ༈ lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgom bzlas bzhugs so// 10 ༈ 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i snang ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang brgyud 'debs/ 11 ༈ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dkar po'i sgom bzlas snying gi mun sel ces bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dkar sgom bzlas/ 12 ༈ rje btsun smra ba'i seng ge'i sgom bzlas blo gros kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// smra seng sgom bzlas/ 13 ༈ tshe dpag med mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gzungs ring 'don pa'i gdams ngag tshigs bcad ma bzhugs so// 14 ༈ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga thar pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'od chog thar pa'i shing rta/ 15 ༈ thub pa'i dbang po dang nye sras brgyad kyi mtshan brgya'i bstod pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa bzhugs so// thub dbang nye sras brgyad mchog 16 ༈ ston pa gnas brtan chen po 'khor dang bcas pa mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga snying por dril ba 'phags pa dgyes pa'i lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so//

gnas chog 'phags pa dgyes pa'i lam mchog bcas bzhugs/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ja) 1 ༈ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis bdud rtsi'i chu gter rab tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi mchod chog 2 ༈ gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs dang 'brel bar sats+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga'i lag len dri med kun snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gtsug tor dri med kyi sats+tsha gdab chog 3 ༈ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad gdab pa'i cho ga mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa las nyung ngur bsdus pa dri med lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// mchod rten brgya rtsa gdab chog dri med lam 'jug 4 ༈ 'phags pa 'od zer dri med kyi rgyun gyi bzlas pa bya tshul 'chi med 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'od zer dri med rgyun bzlas/ 5 ༈ dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas/ 6 ༈ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i bzlas lung sgrub thabs ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phags pa'i lam gyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// nam mkha'i snying po'i ltung bshags cho ga 7 ༈ nam snying bshags chog gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs in+d+ra nī la'i phreng ba bzhugs so// 8 ༈ nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa'i gsung gi dbang phyug chen po'i bsnyen pa'i cho ga bsdus pa zab mo'i ye shes la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi bsnyen pa'i cho ga 9 ༈ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo'i cho ga man ngag ltar bkod pa nyes pa'i gdung sel ces bya ba bzhugs so// thar chog 10 ༈ mdo chog rnams la sbyar bar bya ba'i gshin po rjes 'dzin thar lam snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// 11 ༈ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs dang 'brel bar smyung gnas sgrub pa'i lag len gser sdong g.yu'i phra tshom zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

smyung gnas lag len/ 12 ༈ yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong smyung gnas sgrubs thabs dang 'brel ba'i phan yon mdor bsdus skal ldan ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / smyung gnas phan yon/ 13 ༈ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga mngon dga'i zhing gi rgyan mdzes byed lhan thabs in+d+ra nī la'i chun 'phyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi 'khrugs cho ga'i mdzes rgyan/ 14 ༈ jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas phung po bsreg sbyong gi cho ga 'jam mgon bla ma'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// phung po bsreg sbyong*/ 15 ༈ dpal kun rig gi cho ga rnam grol sgo chen gyi bsnyen sgrub las kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa rnam grol shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kun rig cho ga 16 ༈ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo'i bskyed bzlas rgyun khyer rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gdugs dkar bskyed chog 17 ༈ 'jam dbyangs bla med lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (nya) 1 ༈ phyag chen sngon 'gro gzhi sbyor dang dngos bzhi'i khrid rim mdor bsdus nges don sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 2 ༈ rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig ma bu'i bka' srol chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi khrid yig dri med zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdzogs chen bi ma snying thig ma bu'i khrid yig 3 ༈ sbyor drug stan thog gcig ma'i dmigs khrid mdor bsdus snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 4 ༈ rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod chog bdag 'jug dang bcas pa smin grol snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shangs chos rgyud sde rnams gtsor bsdus mchod chog 5 ༈ dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos las/ rtsa ba ni gu chos drug gi khrid bsdus stan thog cig ma'i nyams len ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ni gu chos drug khrid bsdus/ 6 ༈ shangs pa'i gser chos khrid chen rnam lnga las/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi nyams len dbu ma'i mdud 'gro la ces bya ba bzhugs so// mkha' spyod dkar dmar nyams len/ 7 ༈ tshogs mchod kyi de nyid mdor bsdus smos pa sgyu 'phrul rgyan gyi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mkha' spyod dkar dmar nyams len gyi tshogs mchod mdor bsdus/ 8 ༈ shangs lugs mkha' spyod dkar mo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa 'don 'grigs bltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// mkha' spyod dkar mo'i tshes bcu'i cho ga 9 ༈ shangs lugs mkha' spyod dmar mo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa 'don 'grigs bltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// 10 ༈ shangs lugs mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis kyi tshogs mchod dang rjes chog phrin las yar 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshogs mchod/ 11 ༈ rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi bsnyen yig zab don snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 12 ༈ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi nyams len ye shes rang gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// lha bzhi'i dril sgrub nyams len/ 13 ༈ zab chos ni gu chos drug gi brgyud 'debs nyung 'dus bde chen 'bebs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 14 ༈ shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mchod gtor 'bul ba dkyus ma tsam gyi lag len bzhugs so// 15 ༈ bde mchog dkar po byang chub sgrub lam gyi rdzogs rim tshe khrid dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i gong bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bde mchog dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 16 ༈ bka' bab drug ldan gyi zab khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bka' bab drug ldan brgyud 'debs/ 17 ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa chen po'i nye brgyud yig ge drug pa'i sgom lung 'bogs tshul gzhan phan mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// 18 ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la thugs rje chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i snying po yi ge drug pa'i nyams len gyi gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

19 ༈ rje grub thob chen po dge slong pad+ma dkar por skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bzhugs so// 20 ༈ tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs zab khrid kyi yi ge 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so// grub rgyal tshe khrid/ 21 ༈ gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta khrid/ 22 ༈ blo sbyong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i gdung sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 23 ༈ theg pa chen po blo sbyong don ma'i khrid yig blo dman 'jug bder bkod pa byang chub gzhung lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 24 ༈ blo sbyong smon lam byang sems rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 25 ༈ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen gyi stong thun gdong lnga'i gad mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 26 ༈ tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i gtong thun gsal bar spros pa tshangs pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshogs sgrub spyi'i stong thun/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ta) 1 ༈ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi khrid yig ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shangs lugs lha bzhi dril sgrub khrid yig 2 ༈ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim gnyis 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'babs pa chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'bro lugs dus 'khor brgyud 'debs/ 3 ༈ lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa las 'phros pa'i gtam skabs lnga pa lung dang rig pa'i me tog rab tu dgod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i gtam/ 4 ༈ ris med chos kyi 'byung gnas mdo tsam smos pa blo gsal mgrin pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ris med chos 'byung*/ 5 ༈ chos grwa chen po thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi 'dus ba rgya mtshor bslab bya'i gtam du gsol ba tshogs mchog kun tu dga' ba'i rna rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi bca' yig 6 ༈ shu bha 'brug dgu gling sogs chos 'khor chen po rnams kyi bca' yig blang dor mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// shu bha 'brug dgu gling gi bca' yig 7 ༈ byams mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku seng ge'i khrir phebs pa'i maṇ+ḍal rgyas bshad ngo mtshar sgo brgya 'byed pa'i dga' ston ces bya ba bzhugs so// maṇ+ḍal rgyas bshad/ 8 ༈ dbang bskur byin rlabs sogs kyi rab dbye nyung bsdus blo dman nyams dga' yod do// dbang bskur rab dbye/ 9 ༈ tshe sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dogs sel du smos pa 'od kyi thur ma bzhugs so//

10 ༈ nges don dbu ma chen po la 'khrul rtog nyer gsum gyi 'bur 'joms pa legs bshad gser gyi tho ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// nges don dbu ma'i 'khrul 'joms/ 11 ༈ dris len rna ba'i bdud rtsi bzhugs so// 12 ༈ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi zhal sngar rgyal dbang karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rjes bka' 'dri phul ba len dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 13 ༈ tsā 'dra'i gnas 'dus dge bskul sgo byang*/ 14 ༈ zhwa dmar lo rgyus/ 15 ༈ spros med rgyun gyi nyams len ku sā le'i bdud rtsi bzhugs so// 16 ༈ dpa' bo'i dbu zhwa'i bshad pa mdor bsdus/ 17 ༈ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo lhan skyes kyi rgyun khyer dang rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa stan thog gcig pa'i dmigs sdom lhan skyes grub ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus 'khor rgyun khyer/ 18 ༈ ring 'tsho'i cho ga sgrub pa'i rnam par bzhag pa 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa'i don 'grel tshe dbang dga' ba 'khyil ba'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ring 'tsho'i cho ga'i rnam bzhag 19 ༈ rang gzhan la gtan gros gdams ngag gi tshul du brjod pa'i phreng ba snying gi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// nyams mgur zhal gdams skor/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (tha) 1 ༈ rje 'chi med pad+ma'i mdzad pa dran/ 2 ༈ na mo gu ra be/ dal 'byor lan gcig thob 'dir/ 3 ༈ brda sprod gzhung lugs kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod phreng ba bstar ba lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// brda sprod mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ 4 ༈ lha dbang bkra shis la gnang ba'i zhal gdams bzhugs so// 5 ༈ nyams mgur/ 6 ༈ a ho/ sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i ya mtshan gyi ltad mo// 7 ༈ na mo gu ru/ chos kun rtsa ba sems yin pas/ 8 ༈ zhal gdams/ 9 ༈ he āng d+bhu taṃ dṛ ṣ+ṭa/ dga' ldan gnam du sogs rtogs brjod/ 10 ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ// rtag brtan 'gyur med yongs grub bde gshegs sogs rdor slob karma rin chen la gnang ba/

11 ༈ rje btsun ma hā gu rur 'dud sogs gter ston zhig la gnang ba/ 12 ༈ bslab bya legs par brjod pa skabs bzhi pa bzhugs so// 13 ༈ yab sras skyes chen rnams la dngos po'i mchod sprin phul ba'i yi ge'i phreng ba rdzogs ldan sprin gyi bla bre zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'bul yig 14 ༈ rang dang gzhan bskul gyis ngor bris pa'i yig bskur tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba mtsho byung mgrin pa'i rol rtsed zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gsung len chab shog skor/ 15 ༈ thub dbang rten gsum mthong grol lha khang 'dzam gling bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi dkar chag rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dbyangs snyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// dgon chen jo bo'i dkar chag 16 ༈ rje dbon bla ma dam pa'i dgongs rdzogs rten gsum gyi dkar chag mdor bsdus pa ngo mtshar dpal skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// mchog gling gter dbon gdung rten dkar chag 17 ༈ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi gser chos rin po che'i mdzod yongs su phye ba'i dkar chag baiḍūr+ya'i lde'u mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// shangs chos yig rnying dkar chag 18 ༈ paṇa chen dran pa ye shes zhabs kyi sku 'bum dkar chag sngar grags sor bzhag tu brjod pa rna ba'i gling bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dran thang paṇa chen smṛ ti dzñā na'i sku 'bum dkar chag 19 ༈ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam gyi dkar chag smon tshig dang 'brel pa ngo mtshar rab dga'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shangs chos sher phyin dkar chag 20 ༈ thub dbang sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan gyi dkar chag bzhugs so// sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (da) 1 ༈ dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkar chag zhing khams kun tu khyab pa'i sgra snyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// 2 ༈ dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling gi sgrub pa rnams kyi kun spyod bca' khrims blang dor rab gsal phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

yang khrod sgrub sde'i bca' yig 3 ༈ mchog gzigs bla ma dam pa g.yung drung phun tshogs kyi gdung rten dkar chag lha'i sgra snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bon bla g.yung drung phun tshogs gdung rten dkar chag 4 ༈ khyad par bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi rtog pa brjod pa yongs 'dus me tog gsar pa'i phreng ba dpyod ldan rna rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// bdud rtsi sman sgrub khyad par bcu gsum rtogs brjod/ 5 ༈ bdud rtsi chos sman phan yon zur bkol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sman sgrub phan bde/ 6 ༈ gdan sa chen po thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi bla brang dben pa zla mdzes su bzhugs pa'i dpe deb rin po che 'phrul gyi lde'u mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// dpal spungs dpe mdzod deb kyi mgo rgyan/ 7 ༈ dpal gyi tsā ri tra'i bsngags brjod mdor bsdus dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin dbyangs bzhugs so// 8 ༈ thugs kyi gnas mchog chen po de bī ko ṭī tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi rtog pa brjod pa yid kyi rgya mtsho'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi gnas yig 9 ༈ rdzong chen khams phug 'od gsal grub pa'i rtse mo'i dkar chag gter byon zur 'debs dad pa'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdzong chen khams phug gnas yig 10 ༈ g.yung drung rnam par bkod pa'i gnas mchog chen po'i mdo byang gsal byed snying por bsdus pa bzhugs so// 11 ༈ kun mkhyen bla ma rin po che'i khyad par gyi rnam thar la ched du brjod pa u dum+ba ra'i dga' tshal bzhugs/ mkhyen brtse'i rtogs brjod/ 12 ༈ gsol 'debs/ 13 ༈ thub dbang gnas brtan gtso 'khor gyi gser thang bdun tshar gyi gtso thang rgyab byang*/ 14 ༈ spar byang*/ 15 ༈ bla ma dgongs 'dus spar byang*/ 16 ༈ bla ma dgongs 'dus gtso dgu bka' gter srung ba'i dbang po gnyis dang bcas pa'i zhal thang gra tshar bcu gcig gi gtso bo so so'i zhal byang*/

dgongs 'dus zhal thang zhal byang*/ 17 ༈ 'jam dpal byin brlabs sogs smon lam/ 18 ༈ zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bsnyen yig mdor bsdus rnam grol don gsal ces bya ba bzhugs so// zhi khro'i bsnyen yig 19 ༈ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur gyi lag len gsal byed bzhugs so// chos dbang bla ma gsang 'dus dbang gi lag len/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (na) 1 ༈ pad gling kun bzang dgongs 'dus smin grol 'bogs pa'i lag len/ 2 ༈ dben gnas lha brtse'i bca' yig ldeb/ 3 ༈ rgyun khyer lus sbyin 'khrul rtog gcod pa'i ral gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 4 ༈ rgyal dbyangs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i rngam sgra bzhugs so// 5 ༈ rdzong shod gnas bstod/ 6 ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub yan lag rnam pa gnyis kyi khog dbub yid bzhin dngos grub 'byung ba'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mchog gling thugs sgrub rnam gnyis kyi sgrub khog 7 ༈ tshogs bdag gtor 'bul/ 8 ༈ rten la nang gzhug 'bul ba'i lag len lugs srol kun gsal dri bral nor bu chu shel gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gzungs 'bul lag len/ 9 ༈ gzungs sgrub zin bris/ 10 ༈ gser 'phru'i gzungs 'bul/ 11 ༈ gnod sbyin lha mang gi 'khrul 'khor bca' sgrub kyi lag len rnam gsal du bkod pa rin chen rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gnod sbyin lha mang gi 'phrul 'khor lag len/ 12 ༈ par byang*/ 13 ༈ mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang bshad skal ldan yid kyi ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang bshad/ 14 ༈ bde gshegs sman bla mched brgyad mchod pa'i cho ga'i phan yon mdor bsdus rna ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sman chog phan yon/ 15 ༈ sman chog gzhan phan bde 'jug dang 'brel bar stong mchod bya tshul bzhugs so// stong mchod lag len/ 16 ༈ sman bla'i bsgom bzlas/ 17 ༈ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi gsum las dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye'i las kyi cho ga zhib mo rnam par gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye'i lag len/ 18 ༈ thun mtshams rnal 'byor la nye bar mkho ba gsar rnying gi gdams ngag snying po bsdus pa dgos pa kun tshang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thun mtshams chos spyod/ 19 ༈ nyes bshags mdor bsdus dag byed bdud rtsi'i thegs ma bzhugs so// 20 ༈ so thar gyi bshags sdom zhi gnas gso sbyong dang 'brel pa nyes ltung dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// so thar bshags sdom/ 21 ༈ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi bka' srol dang 'brel ba'i byang sdom nyes bshags nor bu ke ta ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// byang sems bshags sdom/ 22 ༈ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi ring lugs dang 'brel pa rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi nyes ltung bshags pa kun tu bzang po'i khrus chu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gsang sngags nyes bshags/ 23 ༈ sangs rgyas sras gcig gi rgyud zab mo rgyun khyer du bya ba'i yan lag mdor bsdus pa 'khrul snang rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sangs rgyas sras gcig rgyud bklag thabs/ 24 ༈ rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi nyes ltung phyir bcos pa'i cho ga rig 'dzin dbugs dbyung gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sngags kyi ltung ba phyir bcos/ 25 ༈ gcod yul rgya mtsho'i snying po stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i tshul zab mo'i yang zhun ces bya ba bzhugs so// gcod kyi nyams len stan thog gcig ma/ 26 ༈ gsur mchod 'don yon sprin phung bzhugs so// 27 ༈ gnas chen byin 'bebs zin bris bzhugs so// 28 ༈ bla ma rtsa gsum gtsor gyur rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter byon lha tshogs rnams kyi bsangs mchod zhing khams kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// 'ja' tshon gter byon rtsa gsum spyi bsangs/ 29 ༈ 'ba' lung bsang mchod/ 30 ༈ rgyun gyi bsangs mchod dge legs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 31 ༈ ri khrus khyim khrus gaṅgā'i zegs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

32 ༈ ri khrus khyim khrus/ 33 ༈ bsangs bsdus/ 35 ༈ bsang gser skyems mdor bsdus/ 36 ༈ bcom ldan 'das rig byed ma'i bskang ba dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 37 ༈ gnas mchog rdzong chen khams phug yan lag dang bcas pa'i gsol mchod dge legs kyi tam+bur zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdzong shod gnas srung*/ 38 ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las/ bla ma nor lha'i bsangs mchod dgos 'dod sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma nor lha'i bsang*/ 39 ༈ a lo dpal de'u'i bsang ldeb/ 40 ༈ sku rje ge sar bsangs mchod dgos 'dod char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 41 ༈ rgyun bsang*/ 42 ༈ a rab yul lha rag nyag gnyan po'i bsang mchod bzhugs so// 43 ༈ yul lha'i bsang*/ 44 ༈ yang yul lha spyi bsang*/ 45 ༈ dpa' 'og yul lha spyi bsang*/ 46 ༈ 'bur mo'i bsang*/ 47 ༈ 'byung ba spyi'i nyes pa sel bar byed pa'i gtsug lag gi gyer gto chen po'i bca' gzhi lag len gsal bar byed pa gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'a byung spyi'i nyes sel gyer gto chen mo'i lag len/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (pa) 1 ༈ rdo rje'i chos srung rnams la phrin las su gsal ba don gnyis grub pa'i dpyid ces bya ba bzhugs so// 2 ༈ ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i phan byed man ngag phran tshegs zur du bkol ba bzhugs/ 3 ༈ kar lugs ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi bsnyen pa'i gsal byed/ 4 ༈ bsnyen pa gtong thabs/ 5 ༈ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor sgrub chen mo'i lag len bltas chog tu bkod pa dngos grub rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor sgrub lag len/ 6 ༈ mgon po'i spos sbyor rgyas bsdus kyi lag len bzhugs so// 7 ༈ bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i yang bcud shes rab snying po'i mdo la brten pa'i bdud zlog bar chad kun sel lag len/

bltas chog tu bkod pa rnam thar stobs skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// sher snying bdud bzlog cho ga 8 ༈ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma g.yul bzlog bltas chog tu bkod pa bden 'bras myur ston ces bya ba bzhugs so// sgrol ma g.yul bzlog 9 ༈ dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge mchog dman kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mkhyud dpyad mtshams sbyor/ 10 ༈ tshogs gsog gi rim pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sdom pa gsum gyi gso sbyong rgyas bsdus thar pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sdom gsum gso sbyong*/ 11 ༈ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po mthing dkar gnyis kyi mnga' gsol dge legs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// phyag drug dkar mthing gnyis kyi mnga' gsol/ 12 ༈ ye shes mgon po traka shad kyi bskang gsol las bzhi myur 'grub bzhugs so// bskang gsol/ 13 ༈ 'phags pa dzam+bha la dkar po'i bstod pa dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dzam dkar bstod pa/ 14 ༈ dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma'i phrin las rdo rje nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// smin lugs sngags srung mchod phrin/ 15 ༈ dud sol ma gtso bor gyur pa'i lha mo spyi yi mchod gsol skye ba lnga ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 16 ༈ bka' drin lha mo'i gsol mchod bsam don lhun grub bzhugs so// 17 ༈ ḍā ki su kha sid+dhi'i skong ba phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// 18 ༈ dam can skyes bu chen po'i mchod bstod gsol skong bsang bcas phyogs 'dus legs pa kun tshang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dam can gsol kha/ 19 ༈ dam chos bdud kyi gcod yul gyi rtsa gsum chos srung bcas pa'i gtor 'bul snying po bcud ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gcod yul bka' srung gtor 'bul/ 20 ༈ rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pa la gtor 'bul gyi rim pa khyer bde rig 'dzin dga' ston ces bya ba bzhugs so//

gtor 'bul rig 'dzin dga' ston/ 21 ༈ dam can skyes bu chen po mched 'khor bcas pa'i mnga' gsol dgos 'dod kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 22 ༈ dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po'i gsol kha dang skong ba nyung bsdus bzhugs/ zhing skyong gsol kha/ 23 ༈ rmugs 'dzin dmar po'i skong ba longs spyod char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dzam dmar skong ba/ 24 ༈ mchog gling rnam sras gtor ma'i zin tho/ 25 ༈ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi skong gsol rin chen char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 26 ༈ nye ba'i 'thung gcod rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i gnas bdag rtsa gsum zhing skyong gi mchod sprin 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i gsol mchod/ 27 ༈ 'dul ba mdo rtsa las 'byung ba'i ri mo'i bri yig tshangs pa'i pa tra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 28 ༈ bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum gyi rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi gtso bo rags bsdus zhal thang bkod yig nor bu cha shel gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 29 ༈ tshe dpag med la sogs pa'i gzungs kyi sgra bsgrubs nor bu skar mdog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 30 ༈ brda sprod pa tsān+d+ra pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i ti dra mtha'i dper brjod nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (pha) 1 ༈ 'tsho byed las dang po la nye bar mkho ba'i zin tig gces par btus pa bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sman gyi zin tig bdud rtsi'i thig 2 ༈ pad+ma badz+ra'i gnas 'dren dkyil 'khor bri yig 3 ༈ bag ma'i mda' bshad/ 4 ༈ bag ma la dge ba'i las phran bdun gyi cho ga bkra shis dpal skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// bag ma la dge ba'i las phran bdun pa/ 5 ༈ rtsis kyi bstan bcos nyer mkho bum bzang las skar rtsis kyi lag len 'jug bder bsdebs pa legs bshad kun 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rtsis gzhung legs bshad kun 'dus/ 6 ༈ skar rtsis kyi sngon 'gro rin chen me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi pham gsung*/ 7 ༈ gtsug lag rtsis kyi sngon 'gro rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'byung rtsis sngon 'gro/ 8 ༈ zla ba sgra gcan la 'jug pa'i gtam dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ zla ba sgra gcan dwangs shel me long*/ 9 ༈ nyi ma sgra gcan la 'jug pa'i gtam nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ nyi ma sgra can nor bu'i me long*/ 10 ༈ rab yid shing mo sbrul lo'i l̥ thu'u 'go brjod ko ki la'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rab yid shing mo sbrul lo'i l̥ thu'u 'go brjod/

11 ༈ legs spyad byang chub kyi rgya mtshor spel ba'i tshig gi phreng bzla 'od bdud rtsi'i char pa zhes bya ba bzhugs dang*/ zhar byung spar gyi ldebs su 'khod pa dang*/ mtha' rten bsngo smon skor la bsngo smon gyi skor zla 'od bdud rtsi'i char pa bcas bzhugs/ 12 ༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum sogs/ 13 ༈ mtshungs bral bla ma sangs rgyas zhabs la 'dud sogs/ 14 ༈ bdag ni 'di bzung skye dang tshe rabs su sogs/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ba) 1 ༈ skad gnyis shan sbyar la nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris las dang po pa 'jug pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 2 ༈ 'du shes gsum ldan spong ba pa'i gzugs brnyan pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i dum bu smrig rgyu'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 3 ༈ rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus pa ngo mtshar u dum+ba ra'i dga' tshal ces bya ba bzhugs so// mkhyen brtse'i rnam thar chen mo u dum wa ra'i dga' tshal/ 4 ༈ g.yang sgo 'byed pa'i cho ga rin chen lde'u mig bzhugs so// 5 ༈ lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang chog gi zur 'debs yongs 'du'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 6 ༈ lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyobs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 7 ༈ mdun skyed/ 8 ༈ dpal chen mo srid gsum g.yang bdag dang bcas pa'i bsangs mchod nor bu'i char sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// srid gsum g.yang bdag bsangs mchod/ 9 ༈ dpal chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa la rgyun gyi gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa dngos grub g.yang 'khyil ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgyun gyi gtor 'bul/ 10 ༈ lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs kyi lhan thabs mjug gi cho ga dge legs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

g.yang skyabs kyi lhan thabs/ 11 ༈ gsung mgur gsar du rnyed pa/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// 'jam mgon kong sprul rgya chen bka' mdzod/ (ma) 1 ༈ rnam dkar smon lam lhag bsam zla 'od ces bya ba bzhugs/ 2 ༈ dpal ldan bla ma dam par mnyes pa tshul bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don dang 'brel ba mdo sngags kun gyi yang snying bzhugs so// bla ma lnga bcu pa'i smon lam/ 3 ༈ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa dang rjes su mthun par gdab pa 'brel bcas gtan bde'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sman bla mched brgyad smon lam/ 4 ༈ gsol 'debs dang smon lam thor bu gzhan phan snang ba bzhugs so// 5 ༈ shrī shrī shrī/ swa sti sogs smon tshig / 6 ༈ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che thar par bgrod pa'i lam spyi'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam mthar pa'i gru chen ces bya ba bzhugs so// bstan pa spyi smon/ 7 ༈ bdud rtsi sman gyi smon lam bdud rtsi'i myu gu zhes bya bzhugs/ 8 ༈ phyogs med ris med kyi bstan pa la 'dun shing dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan 'chang ba blo gros mtha' yas kyi sde'i byung ba brjod pa nor bu sna tshogs mdog can ces bya ba zhugs so// 9 ༈ rje kun gzigs 'jam mgon ngag gi dbang phyug yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi 'das rjes kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar nor bu'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'das rjes rnam thar bkra 'phel gsung*/ 10 ༈ rgyal bas lung bstan shing rta chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde'i zhabs kyi gsung 'bum rin po che rgya chen bka'i mdzod kyi dkar chag mdor bsdus zab rgyas rgya mtsho mtha' yas la 'jug pa'i grub bo bzhugs so// bka' 'bum dkar chag bkra 'phel gsung*/ sarba maṅga laṃ/
